notes: As printed ((1/n^2) Sum_{j<=n} a(j) -> 0.196...) false: A064016_literal_false proves it tends to +infinity. Intended a(n)/10^(2n) -> 1/2 - 3/pi^2 proved: A064016_tendsto, from sum_totient_tendsto (Mertens: Sum_{k<=N} phi(k)/N^2 -> 3/pi^2) via phi = mu * id, Tannery with bound 1/d^2, Sum mu(d)/d^2 = 1/zeta(2) = 6/pi^2 (Mathlib LSeries_zeta_mul_Lseries_moebius, riemannZeta_two). a defined as Sum_{k in Icc 1 (10^n)} (k - totient k) as in the entry. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (data a(0..6) rechecked by certificate/check.py).

sources.cite: F. Mertens, Ueber einige asymptotische Gesetze der Zahlentheorie, J. reine angew. Math. 77 (1874) 289-338; Hardy-Wright, Theorem 330
sources.what: Sum_{k<=N} phi(k) = 3N^2/pi^2 + O(N log N), which gives the intended limit
